$comment: Machine-readable update manifest. Bump latestVersion, versionCode and the download URLs with every release. The desktop app prefers electron-updater (latest.yml on GitHub Releases); this file is the stable, cacheable endpoint for anything that cannot use it, and for future mobile builds.
releaseNotes: Syntax highlighting now actually registers — the grammars were throwing on startup
rosbridge panel shows ws://localhost:9090 instead of a broken string, so Connect works
Terminal opens once instead of every launch (stops stale-layout warnings)
In-app update pill: 'Update to v…' appears in the title bar when a release ships
Live URDF / Xacro 3D preview beside the editor
